concept: The Western PA custard institution is building a drive-thru on the old Avis lot on Babcock - twist cones, sundaes and Arctic Swirls without leaving the car, the first Meadows built for the North Hills.

name: Highball Social Club
address: The Plaza at North Shore, Mazeroski Way & General Robinson St, Pittsburgh
concept: From the HiLife crew behind Burgatory and Shorty's: calzones, wood-fired pizza and Italian street food flying across two bars in a 15,200-square-foot hall wedged against PNC Park.

name: Amboy
concept: Chef Rafael Vencio grew the Filipino produce, sold out the pop-ups, and now plants his first brick-and-mortar in a long-vacant corner of East Ohio St — farm-rooted Filipino, with an address at last.
note: replaces a long-vacant former Subway

name: Casa Anchoa
concept: Shore-driven coastal seafood from the Balvanera duo, with Argentine-coast-born chef Fernando Navas reviving the long-dark former Nine on Nine fine-dining room.

name: ELIA Estiatorio
concept: Fresh seafood and craft cocktails on a heated Fifth Avenue Place patio with live entertainment nightly — ELIA, the beloved Warrendale Greek grille, goes white-tablecloth downtown, moussaka, pastitsio and souvlaki in tow.
